title: Offices of Christ
definition: The offices of Christ describe His saving work as Prophet, Priest, and King. As Prophet He reveals God; as Priest He offers Himself and intercedes; as King He reigns and rules.
summary: These offices gather together the fullness of Christ’s ministry. He teaches the truth of God, reconciles sinners to God, and reigns over the people of God.
christFocus: Christ is all that we need: the Word who reveals God, the Priest who brings us to God, and the King who rules us in grace and righteousness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: As Prophet, Christ reveals the Father and speaks the words of life.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: As Priest, Christ offers Himself once for all and continues to intercede.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: As King, Christ subdues, governs, protects, and brings His people into His kingdom.
